subject: Food Science
title: Raw Milk Controversy
description: A short lesson to help you apply Raw Milk Controversy.

hook.text: Raw milk sales are banned in 20 US states. Advocates call it a health food. Public health agencies call it a hazard.

buildup.text: Raw milk can carry Salmonella, E. coli, Listeria, and Campylobacter. Pasteurization eliminates these pathogens reliably.

discovery.text: Between 1993 and 2012, raw milk caused 127 outbreaks and nearly 2,000 illnesses in the US—despite being a niche product.

twist.text: Raw milk advocates claim beneficial enzymes and probiotics are killed by pasteurization. Studies show minimal difference.

climax.text: Children under 5 are 150 times more likely to be hospitalized from raw milk than adults. The risk isn't evenly distributed.

punchline.text: Minimal benefit, significant risk. The science is clear, even if the debate isn't.

quiz.question: What is the scientific consensus on raw milk's nutritional advantage over pasteurized milk?
options: Raw milk is far more nutritious
Studies show minimal nutritional difference between raw and pasteurized
